description: Search Naver Blog posts by one or more keywords, fetch every post from a blog, or get full post details for a list of URLs.

blogIds.description: Naver blog IDs or blog URLs (mode=blogPosts). Accepts `hello_world123`, `@hello_world123`, or `https://blog.naver.com/hello_world123`.
blogIds.title: Blog IDs

categoryNo.description: Naver blog category number to restrict a blog archive; 0 means all categories (mode=blogPosts).
categoryNo.title: Category number

dateFrom.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (KST). Used when publishedWithin=custom (mode=search).
dateFrom.title: Date from

dateTo.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (KST). Used when publishedWithin=custom (mode=search).
dateTo.title: Date to

includeComments.description: Add the comment count and comment threads up to maxComments (default 100), including replies when Naver returns them. Implies includeContent=true and adds requests per post.
includeComments.title: Include comments

includeContent.description: Fetch each post page for full text, exact publish time, images, tags, category, and places. Turn off for faster list-level records.
includeContent.title: Include full content

includeHtml.description: Add the post body as HTML in contentHtml. Implies includeContent=true.
includeHtml.title: Include content HTML

maxComments.description: Maximum comments to return per post when includeComments is on. Fetched in pages of 100; commentCount still reports the full total.
maxComments.title: Max comments per post

maxConcurrency.description: Parallel post-page requests when content enrichment is enabled.
maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records across all queries, blogs, or URLs.
maxItems.title: Max items

enumTitles: Fetch posts from a specific blog
Get full post details for a list of URLs
mode.title: Mode

postUrls.description: Naver blog post URLs to fetch in detail (mode=postDetails). Accepts desktop, mobile, PostView, and bare `blogId/logNo` forms.
postUrls.title: Post URLs

publishedWithin.description: Limit keyword search results by publish period (mode=search). Choose Custom to use dateFrom and dateTo.
publishedWithin.title: Published within

searchQueries.description: One or more Korean or English keywords to search across Naver Blog (mode=search). Each query is searched up to Naver's 1,000-result limit.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

title: Naver Blog Scraper Input
